V1: Initial Release
V1.1: updated to support raised AB (thanks Dogenado)

This is a brace end (loosely copied from a strike industries brace) designed to fit on a JMAC AB. It uses the cross hinge pin to secure to the AB. It requires some M6 hardware. 

This was designed using a clone brace, so I am hoping to get some feedback on a real JMAC AB to make sure it's fully compatible. Please provide feedback so I can make it better
